gui.radio-smile.radio.title: Radio
config.radio-smile.title: Radio Settings
config.radio-smile.enableStreaming.tip: When off, radios stay silent but the UI still works
config.radio-smile.maxBandwidth.tip: Expected audio stream bandwidth. The server derives chunk sizes from this; actual values adapt to network conditions
config.radio-smile.maxChunk.tip: Largest audio payload per packet. Bigger chunks reduce overhead but raise latency and memory use
config.radio-smile.buffer.tip: Target audio buffer duration. Larger tolerates more jitter but adds delay
config.radio-smile.showStats.tip: Display chunk sizes and buffer levels in the radio screen
config.radio-smile.hint.bandwidth: Note: the bandwidth limit is a target; chunk sizes adapt to network conditions and never exceed Max chunk size.
command.radio-smile.reloaded: Radio config reloaded: %s station(s), playback progress reset (epoch %s)
